concerns.text: Task T051 (TreeSHAP and permutation‑importance analyses) consumes a *final* DFT‑enhanced model trained on the full dataset, but no preceding task explicitly produces that final model. T049 only runs outer‑fold cross‑validation; it does not generate a full‑dataset model artifact required by T051 (and similarly by T052). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; a dedicated model‑training task (e.g., “train final model on full data”) must be inserted before T051/T052.
